Triggers: new safe purchase or delivery, home purchase or sale, renovation, estate settlement, job relocation, and dealer delivery. Buying criteria: method over muscle (survey and floor check before anything lifts), discretion (strangers in the home, exact placement, no public review afterward), exact placement in the chosen room and spot verified, one flat price in writing, and no damage to floors, stairs, or trim. Review asymmetry, stated as mechanism: high-value clients do not post public reviews for privacy, so pack position trails on review volume while organic and AI strength hold; pack position is never a quality signal here. The actual searcher asks three questions in order: will my floor hold it, will my stairs carry it, and can I trust strangers in my home with it.
